WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_rate, o.overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages AS ta
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse_rate > o.overall_avg
), second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_of_kept_averages
  FROM above_overall
), final AS (
  SELECT ao.avg_pulse_rate, ao.overall_avg, sa.avg_of_kept_averages
  FROM above_overall AS ao
  CROSS JOIN second_avg AS sa
  WHERE ao.avg_pulse_rate > sa.avg_of_kept_averages
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_overall_average,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - avg_of_kept_averages) AS mean_excess_over_second_average
FROM final;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is across all non-NULL pulsepersec values in signals, with each signal weighted equally; telescope averages include only that telescope's non-NULL values. Telescopes with no non-NULL pulse rate are excluded.
